description: Three long wavy lines run horizontally in evenly spaced rows. Each alternates smoothly between rounded crests and troughs, with matching curves aligned vertically and no enclosing border around the water.
A tornado narrows from a broad oval top through a descending series of curved bands. Beneath it, a tilted map panel contains a winding track and two short dashed marks.
A horizontal sash extends to both sides of a broad rounded central fastening. A small rectangular opening sits inside the fastening, while the two straight belt ends remain aligned behind it.
A single palm tree rises from a low semicircular island with a flat base. Four broad curved fronds spread from the top of its straight trunk, with pointed tips bending outward.

Two rounded squares overlap diagonally, with one above and left of the other. Their continuous outlines cross through the shared central area, leaving the outer corners clearly visible on opposite sides.
A blank oval head narrows into a long neck before widening into sloping shoulders. The front-facing bust has a broad straight bottom edge and softly rounded lower corners without interior details.
A wide rectangular bar sits above a separate long horizontal line. A short vertical stroke appears below their shared center, with generous gaps separating all three elements in the open diagram.
A broad flag extends right from a tall narrow pole with a rounded top. Its upper and lower edges follow matching waves, while the free right edge remains straight and vertical.
A large oval nutmeg leans diagonally behind a smaller cut half at the lower right. Curved grooves mark the whole nut, while an irregular central kernel appears inside the thick cut rim.
A fan-shaped wireless symbol expands upward from a small circular base. Two curved interior divisions follow the broad outer arc, with straight diagonal sides enclosing the stacked open signal bands.

A rounded picture placeholder occupies the upper left of a text layout, beside three short horizontal lines. Three longer lines continue beneath the picture, with the lowest ending short of the others.
A slender paintbrush tilts from lower left to upper right, with a long rounded handle above a short ferrule. Its soft bristle head swells outward before tapering into a curved pointed tip.
A rounded paint palette has an inward thumb notch along its lower right edge. Three small circular paint wells sit around the upper left interior, beside a larger circular opening on the right.
A diagonal paintbrush has a rounded handle separated from its bristles by a broad ferrule. The bristle head spreads into a full curved belly that narrows toward a pointed lower left end.
A front-facing car sits in the lower left before a larger gabled house. The car has a broad windscreen and short headlights, while the house has a tall rounded doorway beneath its peaked roof.
A front-facing car waits beside a striped gate post on the left. A long raised barrier arm angles upward across the scene, above the car's broad windscreen, small headlights, and two wheels.
A large circular ornament hangs beneath a short rectangular cap and a rounded loop. The sphere remains entirely blank, with the cap centered above it and the loop rising from the cap.

A tall rectangular building stands beside a small rounded tree on a shared baseline. Short horizontal window marks cross the tower, which has a rooftop block and antenna above a low foreground structure.
A compact pager has a rounded rectangular body, a wide blank display near the top, and three small rounded buttons below. A tiny detached curved mark sits beneath the device.
A long overcoat has broad notched lapels framing an open neckline and a straight central seam. Its sleeves angle outward beside the body, with short diagonal pocket openings near the lower sides.
A closed upright paperback has a blank rectangular front cover with a rounded upper spine corner. A curved page block projects beneath the cover, joining the left spine to the lower right edge.
A thick rope coil lies diagonally with two large open loops at opposite ends. Two broad wraps cross its middle, holding the loops together and interrupting their curved outlines at the center.
A vertically folded rope forms long open loops above and below three horizontal binding wraps. A loose end emerges from the lower right side of the binding and curls downward before turning upward.
A rounded rectangular dashboard is divided into four blank sections. A broad header spans the top, with a tall left panel below and two stacked rectangular panels filling the remaining right side.
A tall blank page has rounded left and lower corners beneath a folded upper right corner. The fold creates a triangular flap above the broad open face, with a curved inner join.
A rounded square article card contains a small rounded picture panel at the upper right. Two short lines sit to its left, above two longer text lines that extend across the lower area.
A dog faces right beneath a sloping shelter roof, standing on long legs with a pointed ear and muzzle. The shelter has a left wall and floor, leaving its right side open.
A broad domed roof sits above a projecting horizontal cornice and a row of straight columns. The columns rest on a wide raised base, forming a balanced front-facing classical building.
A wide paint roller has a rounded rectangular sleeve with a large droplet hanging beneath it. A bent support arm extends from its right end and curves downward into a vertical rounded handle.
A rounded square wall plate surrounds a smaller rounded socket face. Two vertical slots sit near the upper center of the socket, with one short horizontal grounding slot positioned beneath them.
An irregular rock has a broad polygonal outline with softened corners and an angled top. Long internal seams divide it into several large faces, with a short diagonal mark on the right facet.
A broad uterus narrows downward into a rounded cervical stem. Symmetrical curved tubes extend outward from its upper sides and curl inward at their ends, with a short curve inside the upper body.
Five equal circular rings overlap in two staggered rows. Three rings occupy the upper row, with two below them crossing the spaces between the upper circles in a wide balanced arrangement.
Five broad rounded petals surround a small circular flower center. One petal points upward, two spread to the sides, and two extend downward, with visible seams between the adjoining petal bases.

A pansy flower has overlapping rounded petals around a small central disk with short radiating marks. A straight stem descends beneath the blossom, ending between two pointed leaves that spread outward.
A diamond-shaped kite tilts beside a small cloud at the upper left. Crossing spars divide the kite into triangular panels, and a loose curved tail descends from its lower point.
A folded omelet forms a broad half-oval tilted upward to the right. Its upper edge runs diagonally between rounded ends, while a curling interior mark and a short lower curve suggest surface folds.
A fruit tree with three round fruits rises from a curved hill beside a short fence. Its broad lobed crown rests on a straight trunk, with crossing fence rails on the left.
A panda face has a large rounded head with two small round ears at the top. Two tilted oval eye patches sit above a small curved triangular muzzle near the lower center.
A hand grips an upright drill stick above a horizontal log with a circular left end. Short radiating marks flank the contact area, while the wrist extends out to the right.
A paint spray gun has a rounded horizontal body and an angled grip beneath it. A bottle hangs from the lower front connection, while three separated spray lines fan outward from the nozzle.
A winter parka has a large rounded hood above a straight central opening. Long sleeves angle outward beside the body, with two horizontal pocket openings and a short zipper detail near the right hem.
Two slender stockinged legs cross in profile, with one leg straight and the other bent forward at the knee. The raised foot points down, crossing in front of the supporting shin.

An elongated pancreas tapers toward the upper right and widens into a rounded head on the left. A broad curved intestinal loop wraps around the head, with interior curves separating the adjoining forms.
A standing person has a separate circular head above a broad rounded torso. Short arms hang beside the body, and a vertical lower division separates two straight legs with softly rounded feet.
A plain ice cream bar has a tall rounded rectangular body with a domed upper edge. A narrow stick extends centrally beneath it, ending in a rounded tip below the frozen treat.
An oil pump jack has a long sloping beam above a tapered lattice support. A curved horsehead hangs at the left, with vertical rods descending from both ends toward a shared ground line.

A tall pantry cabinet has a broad rounded outer frame surrounding a rectangular front. Two horizontal divisions create three sections, with a short vertical handle near the right edge of the middle section.
A castle facade has two crenellated side towers and a taller central tower with a pointed roof. A rounded doorway opens below the central wall, beneath one narrow vertical window slit.
A front-facing knight wears a domed helmet with a small plume above a broad visor. A narrow eye opening crosses the faceplate, with three vertical vents below and rounded shoulders beneath.

A tall rectangular office building has four square windows arranged above a centered doorway. A shorter blank annex stands against its right side, with both structures resting on a shared horizontal baseline.

An upright sheet has rounded lower corners and a diagonally clipped upper right corner. A dashed horizontal fold guide crosses its middle, meeting a shorter dashed vertical guide descending from the top.
A desktop monitor rests on a short central stand above a wide desk. The desk has a narrow left leg and a rounded right pedestal divided by one horizontal drawer seam.
A tall jerry can has rounded corners, a small raised cap at the upper left, and a sloping upper shoulder. A triangular rounded handle opening occupies the upper right portion of the body.
An open brochure has two tall rectangular panels meeting along a central vertical fold. Its top and bottom edges angle inward at the fold, with three short parallel text lines on the right panel.
An open hand faces forward with four long fingers held upright and a thumb angled outward to the left. A curved palm crease sweeps inward from the thumb base above the open wrist.
A straight herb stem carries two pairs of pointed oval leaves and one upright terminal leaf. Short diagonal branches connect the side leaves to the stem, alternating around its central vertical line.
An otoscope extends horizontally toward a large ear outline on the right. Its tapered head ends in a short narrow tip, with a vertical handle below and a curved inner ear contour opposite it.
An ox head faces forward with a long tapered face and broad rounded muzzle. Two large horns curve outward and upward above small side ears, leaving the central face blank.
A broad open oyster shell has a scalloped upper edge and tapered lower sides. A large round pearl sits in its center, above a shallow curved lower shell lip at the base.
Three circular atoms form an uneven triangle, with one at the left and two stacked on the right. Straight connecting bonds join each pair, enclosing a small open triangular space between them.

A pair of plain trousers has a broad horizontal waistband above two long straight legs. The outer sides spread slightly toward the hems, while a deep central opening separates the legs below the crotch.
Five vertical panpipe tubes hang beneath a broad rounded horizontal binding. Their rounded lower ends step upward from the longest tube on the left to the shortest tube on the right.
A glue stick tilts from lower left to upper right with a long rounded casing and a blank rectangular label. A seam separates the upper cap, while a rounded base projects below.
A tall paper packet leans slightly to the right with a broad blank front and a narrow folded side. Horizontal seams cross the top and bottom, and the lower right corner forms a small gusset.
A long rounded paperclip lies diagonally from lower left to upper right. Its outer loop wraps around a smaller elongated inner loop, with smooth parallel sides and broadly curved ends.
An upright parchment sheet curls backward at its upper left and forward across the bottom. A short wavy mark sits in the otherwise blank center, between the long straight sides of the scroll.

A small person hangs beneath a wide arched paraglider canopy, with a circular head and straight narrow torso. Diagonal suspension lines descend from the canopy toward the shoulders above two spread legs.

Two pointed pine trees stand on overlapping curved hills, with the larger tree at the left. Their tiered triangular foliage rests on thin straight trunks rising from separate slopes in the foreground.
A rounded cloud releases five diagonal rain strokes above three small seedlings on a straight ground line. Each sprout has two curved leaves opening outward from a short central stem.
Three paired-leaf sprouts grow along a horizontal baseline beneath a broad lobed cloud. Five short slanting rain marks fall between the cloud and plants in two staggered rows across the open gap.
A small car faces forward in front of the left side of a peaked house. Its windscreen and short headlights sit below the house's tall arched doorway and broad sloping roof.
A long vertical arrow shaft rises from below and bends smoothly toward the right near its top. The horizontal end meets two diagonal arrowhead branches, forming an open right-pointing tip.
A low circular puck is shown in perspective with a wide oval top and straight short sides. A curved lower edge joins the sides, making the thickness visible beneath its blank upper face.
A long sanitary pad has rounded ends and a smaller rounded absorbent panel running down its center. Two broad rounded wings project from opposite sides at the middle of the pad.
A plain square parcel has a narrow sealing strip descending from the center of its top edge. The strip ends in an inward V-shaped notch, leaving the rest of the box face blank.
A carrot has a rounded shoulder tapering downward into a long pointed root. Three narrow rounded leaf stems fan from the top, with short horizontal root marks alternating along the sides.
An open parachute has a broad domed canopy divided into curved vertical panels. The scalloped lower canopy edge joins long suspension lines that converge at one point directly beneath the center.
A shopping basket has a broad rounded rim above a body that tapers to a flat lower edge. One large arched handle rises behind the rim, centered over the empty basket.
A partridge faces right with a small pointed beak and a full rounded breast. A large curved wing follows its sloping back, while a long tail extends left above one visible thin leg.
A plump oval olive hangs beneath a short curved stem, leaning slightly to the right. One pointed leaf extends diagonally upward from the stem, with a smooth blank surface inside both outlines.
An opossum faces left with a pointed muzzle, small rounded ear, and hunched body. Short bent legs tuck beneath it, while a long tail follows the right haunch and curves left below.
A seated orangutan faces forward with small round side ears and a broad blank muzzle patch. Its long arms frame the torso, beside two rounded knees resting along the flat lower edge.
A broad storage box has rounded lower corners and a shallow sloping lid across the top. A rounded rectangular tab descends from the lid seam into the middle of the blank front.
Three thick round discs stack evenly beneath a broad oval top. A small oval hole marks the upper face, while parallel curved edges reveal the separate layers across the front.
An ostrich faces right with a small head atop a long curved neck. Its broad body slopes toward a short tail on the left, above two long angular legs with flat feet.
An owl face has two large rounded eye areas beneath sweeping pointed brows. Small circular eyes flank a narrow leaf-shaped beak, while a broad curved outline forms the lower head.
A small circular sun with short straight rays hangs above the left side of a broad rounded hill. The hill rises from a horizontal baseline and forms a smooth dome beneath the open sky.

Two rounded mountain peaks overlap beneath a small circular sun. A straight fence spans the foreground, with two horizontal rails crossing several vertical posts below the open slopes of the mountains.
An irregular crumpled paper ball floats above a tapered wastebasket divided by a rectangular grid. A short curved motion stroke appears at the upper right, above the basket's wide open rim.
A broad rounded travel bag has a large arched handle extending above its top. Two vertical lines continue from the handle down the front, joined by a horizontal seam across the central band.
A tall tree with a lobed crown stands to the left of a simple park bench. The bench has a rectangular backrest above a narrow seat, with short supporting legs beneath it.

A broad pretzel has two rounded outer lobes surrounding an angled central opening. Small leaf-shaped joins appear at the lower left and upper right edges, where the curved dough ends cross the outline.
Two curved rows of pointed oval leaves rise around an open center, leaving a wide gap at the top. Short curved stem ends cross beneath the lowest pair of leaves at the base.
A broad flat paintbrush has a slightly tapered bristle block above a horizontal ferrule seam. The lower body curves inward into a narrow handle with a rounded end beneath the brush.
A single continuous line bends through three broad alternating curves in a tall vertical arrangement. Its upper end begins near the center, while its lower end turns downward along the left side.
A running person leans forward beneath a separate circular head, with both arms bent at the elbows. One leg reaches backward to the left, while the other bends forward and down.
A bird faces right on a straight horizontal perch with a small dot eye and pointed beak. Its curved wing follows the body, and a long tail extends down and left behind one angled leg.
A deep bowl with a broad rim and short foot holds a rounded heap of rice. Several small curved grain marks sit within the scalloped mound rising above the bowl's straight upper edge.
A large rounded capsule tilts diagonally beside a smaller circular tablet at the lower right. A seam divides the capsule across its middle, while a diagonal score line crosses the round tablet.
